_readme: Crisis safety settings. If anything a person writes contains one of these words or phrases, the app stops and shows the caring message below before they can carry on. Add or remove phrases freely (lower case is fine; matching ignores capitals and punctuation, and matches whole words only, so 'die' won't match 'diet'). Have a clinician review this list before launch.

message.title: It sounds like things might be really hard right now
message.text: You don't have to get through this on your own. If you're thinking about suicide or hurting yourself, please reach out now. Talking to someone can help, and they're there for exactly this.
